tagline: Build Real Hardware. Launch Tech Ventures.

treks.summary: Students traveled to Seoul to tour Hanyang University (often referred to as the MIT of Korea), visit startup accelerators including Seoul Startup Hub and Mobidoo, engage in K-Pop cultural classes, and explore Bukchon Hanok Village.
highlights: Hanyang University campus and technology exchange
Seoul Startup Hub and Mobidoo accelerator visits
Korean culinary workshops and cultural immersion

treks.summary: A direct deep-dive into the epicenter of the global semiconductor and electronics manufacturing ecosystem. Students toured TSMC facilities, Taipei Tech labs, Tailyn Technologies assembly lines, and OnLogic international offices.
highlights: TSMC semiconductor fab operations and lithography briefings
Taipei Tech university innovation labs and student exchanges
OnLogic global embedded systems manufacturing facility

treks.summary: An intensive domestic trek connecting E-SHIP students with prominent venture capital firms, high-growth technology startups, and Penn State engineering alumni founders across Manhattan and Brooklyn.
highlights: Top-tier venture capital fund partner discussions
High-growth SaaS and hardware startup office sessions
Customer discovery in the Northeast commercial market

treks.summary: Upcoming trek to the global capital of venture-backed technology. Students will meet with leading Bay Area hardware incubators, artificial intelligence labs, and enterprise technology founders.
highlights: Bay Area hardware accelerators and maker incubators
Meetings with venture capital investment teams
Penn State alumni tech leaders in Silicon Valley
Visits to generative AI and robotic engineering startups

courses.title: Entrepreneurial Mindset
courses.subtitle: Opportunity Recognition and Creative Problem Solving
courses.description: Foundational exploration of the entrepreneurial mindset. Students learn to spot real market friction, evaluate problem spaces, conduct user empathy interviews, and test assumptions before building.
courses.keyDeliverable: Customer problem validation study and initial opportunity memo.

courses.title: Entrepreneurial Leadership
courses.subtitle: High-Performance Team Leadership and Vision
courses.description: Focuses on leading teams through high technical uncertainty. Covers personal leadership styles, team formation, conflict resolution, equity expectations, and driving project velocity.
courses.keyDeliverable: Personal founder leadership roadmap and team charter.

courses.title: Technology-Based Entrepreneurship
courses.subtitle: Rapid Prototyping and the GameDay Ventures Challenge
courses.description: Hands-on hardware sprint. Student teams design, 3D print, and fabricate physical products in the Learning Factory. Concludes with live user field testing at the annual Beaver Stadium GameDay tailgate competition.
courses.keyDeliverable: Working functional physical prototype tested live by actual users.

courses.title: Business Basics for Entrepreneurs
courses.subtitle: Financial Modeling, IP, and Embedded Asia Study Abroad
courses.description: Unit economics, Bill of Materials (BOM) cost projection, cash flow management, and patent analysis. Includes the embedded global study trek to South Korea (Seoul) and Taiwan visiting TSMC, Hanyang University, and tech accelerators.
courses.keyDeliverable: Full 3-year BOM unit economics model and IP filing brief.

courses.title: Technology Launch & Commercialization
courses.subtitle: Go-to-Market Strategy and Manufacturing Scale
courses.description: Bridges engineering prototypes to real production. Covers vendor qualification, contract manufacturing agreements, regulatory compliance (FCC, CE, UL), and customer acquisition channels.
courses.keyDeliverable: Commercialization launch dossier and manufacturing vendor agreement.

courses.title: New Venture Creation
courses.subtitle: Venture Pitch, Angel Defense, and Incubator Transition
courses.description: The capstone venture laboratory. Teams refine viable technology businesses, pitch to active angel investors and venture capitalists, and prepare for entry into Happy Valley LaunchBox or Summer Founders.
courses.keyDeliverable: Formal investor pitch deck, legal corporate structure, and demo day launch.

faculty.name: Ted Graef
faculty.bio: Co-founder and former President of All Traffic Solutions. Serial hardware and IoT entrepreneur with multiple patents in connected municipal traffic systems. Leads the Product Innovation cluster at SEDI.

faculty.name: Brad Groznik
faculty.bio: Founder of Groznik PR and co-founder of Pop Up Ave. Specializes in venture communications, go-to-market positioning, community-driven product adoption, and student founder mentorship.
